[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Matrix diagonal sum** [LC 1572 · Matrix Diagonal Sum](https://leetcode.com/problems/matrix-diagonal-sum/){difficulty="Easy"}

Each diagonal is a one-line relation on the indices — the main diagonal is $i = j$, the anti-diagonal is $i + j = n - 1$ — so row $i$ contributes exactly $a[i][i]$ and $a[i][n-1-i]$. The only trap is parity: when $n$ is odd the centre satisfies both relations and must be counted once, when $n$ is even the diagonals never meet.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p5-diagsum.]{.card-link}

:::
